## Instructions
---

@[card: Follow me](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

@[card: Follow me](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

@[card: Get my stuff here](https://github.com/lonecatone23)

@[card: Get my models here](https://huggingface.co/Lonecatone23)


@[card: Buy me a ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

### This is many hours of work. If you enjoy it, please 👍 like, 💬 comment, and feel free to ⚡ tip 😉

---

### 🛑🚫✋ What this workflow is for
- A test bench for two new nodes: **LC Sigmas** and **LC Detail Daemon**. Same prompt, same model, run two ways, and the comparer shows you the difference.
- **Top path (new):** LC Sigmas builds the schedule, LC Detail Daemon adds detail, and two samplers split the work (first pass, then second pass).
- **Bottom path (baseline):** a plain KSampler on euler / simple. This is "what you would normally get".
- Every setting here came out of a 3,432 image test across Krea 2 Turbo and Raw, Z-Image, Flux 2 Klein, SDXL and Illustrious.

---

**LC Sigmas (BETA) 📉**
- A sigma is just how much noise is left at a step. The schedule is the list of those amounts, start to finish. Big noise = the model decides the big stuff (pose, composition, light). Small noise = fine detail (skin, hair, fabric).
- **sampler:** the green line under the graph tells you what tested best for your model and its shift (Krea 2 at its own shift: euler + beta57). RES4LYF / ClownShark samplers work too, and a ClownSampler Selector can be wired straight in.
- **sigma_curve_presets:** the shape of the schedule. **base** = a plain scheduler (picked in **base_scheduler**), **beta** = your own alpha / beta, **flowmatch**, **hyperbolic** and **gaussian** = the base curve bent by tanh, a bell curve, etc., plus any curve you saved. Only the settings for the one you pick show up.
- **Drag a point on the graph** to bend the curve. **smooth** pulls the neighbours along (**smooth_radius** = how many), **spike** moves just that point. **reset curve** undoes it, **save curve** keeps it as a preset.
- The graph shows your schedule: orange = first pass, blue = second pass, dashed = the model's plain schedule (or your preset before you bent it). It updates live once you have run it. Drag the node taller and the graph grows.
- **step_swap** splits the render into two passes. 0 = one pass. A second model (model_2) can take the second pass, and it always starts at exactly the noise level where the first stopped (no jump).
- **first_pass_resample:** walks the first pass in more steps along the same path. 1 = off.
- **low_pass:** **continue noise schedule** = the second pass finishes the leftover noise. **renoise** = the first pass finishes the picture, then fresh noise goes back up to the swap level, so the clean model has something to refine. This is the one for cleaning up ControlNet. The step swap sets how much it gets: late = clean-up, earlier = heavier refining.
- **denoise** is for image to image. The info line tells you the real starting noise, because on Krea 2 "denoise 0.5" actually starts at 76% noise. **denoise_steps:** **full schedule** = denoise covers the whole run. **at step swap** = it covers the first pass only, so the second pass refines on its own.
- **sigma_shift:** leave it on **use model default**. Higher shift = more steps on composition, lower = more on detail. flowmatch and saved curves ignore it.
- ⚠️ Go easy dragging a **gaussian** curve down. It already keeps the noise high, and a big drag cuts the detail steps short and burns the picture.
- It also outputs the noise for each pass and the sampler, so you do not need RandomNoise, DisableNoise or KSamplerSelect nodes.

**LC Detail Daemon (BETA) 😈**
- Adds detail by telling the model there is a little less noise than there really is, so it removes a little less and keeps more fine texture.
- **amount** uses the same scale as the original Detail Daemon (1.0 = 10% less noise at the peak), but it is never multiplied by your CFG.
- **start / end** are steps, like the original: 0.15 to 0.85.
- **peak** and **exponent** do more than the amount. **peak 0** = strongest at the start of the window, on the noisy steps where it shapes things. **exponent 0** = full strength across the whole window.
- **mode:**
    - **look only** (default): crisp detail without big reshuffles.
    - **classic:** the original. Small things shift (folds, windows, background focus).
    - **keep structure:** only the fine part of the change is kept, so the layout stays exactly where it was. About 45% slower.
- ✋ It sits on the **low pass** (the second sampler). Detail is made in the last steps; on the first pass it moves the layout.
- Its **sigmas** input only draws the graph. The window follows the sampler it is plugged into.
- ⚠️ Samplers that add their own noise (dpmpp_2m_sde, euler_ancestral, er_sde, ClownShark at eta 0.5) plus Detail Daemon can leave specks. Lower the amount with those, or stay on euler.

**Baseline**
- Plain KSampler, euler / simple. Compare it against the new path in the image comparer and judge for yourself.

**Best LC Sigmas Settings**
| Model | sampler + base_scheduler | steps | step_swap (ControlNet) | Detail Daemon amount (look only, low pass) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Krea 2 Turbo / Krealism** | euler + beta57 | 8 | 7 | 1.0 | The everyday setup |
| **Krea 2 Raw** | euler + beta57 | 20 - 30 | 18 - 27 | 0.5 | More steps = it hits harder |
| **Krea 2 + ModelSamplingAuraFlow (shift 4)** | euler + simple | 8 - 10 | 7 - 8 | 1.0 | beta57 at this shift = grain and crunchy skin |
| **Z-Image Turbo** | uni_pc + simple | 8 - 9 | 8 | 0.75 | Takes detail the best |
| **Flux 2 Klein** | uni_pc + simple | 4 | off | off | Too few steps: it shifts the light instead of adding detail |
| **SDXL / Illustrious / Pony** | dpmpp_2m + karras | 25 - 30 | 23 - 27 | 0.75 | Karras is fine here, not on flow models |

**Best Detail Daemon Settings**
| Preset | amount | start | end | peak | exponent | mode | Recommended for | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Balanced** (default) | 1.0 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | look only | Everyday use | The tested setting |
| **Gentle sharpen** | 0.5 | 0.20 | 0.80 | 0.5 | 1 | look only | Portraits, skin | Barely moves anything |
| **Original look** | 0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | classic | The old Detail Daemon feel | Small things shift |
| **Keep layout** | 0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | keep structure | When nothing may move | About 45% slower |
| **Smooth** | -0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | look only | Busy or grainy renders | Negative = smoother, less detail |

### Quick Tips:
- **peak** and **exponent** at 0 is where the punch comes from. Raise them for a gentler sharpen.
- **amount** is the original Detail Daemon's scale: 1.0 = 10% less noise at the peak.
- **classic** and **keep structure** hit harder than look only: start them at half the amount.
- **start / end:** leave the last steps alone, or noise stays in the image.
- 4-step models: not worth it.
- 💡 Want it faster? Put **LC Speed Boost 🚀** between LC Sigmas' sampler and the first sampler: about 2x, same quality, the framing gets a bit tighter.

---

***"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"***- Yoda Auditore, *Assassin's Wars*

## 使用说明
---

@[card: 关注我](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

@[card: 关注我](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

@[card: 在这里获取我的作品](https://github.com/lonecatone23)

@[card: 在这里获取我的模型](https://huggingface.co/Lonecatone23)


@[card: 请我喝杯 ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

### 这是花了许多小时做出来的。如果你喜欢，请 👍 点赞、💬 评论，也欢迎 ⚡ 打赏 😉

---

### 🛑🚫✋ 这个工作流是干什么的
- 两个新节点的测试台：**LC Sigmas** 和 **LC Detail Daemon**。同样的提示词、同样的模型，用两种方式运行，由 comparer 向你展示差异。
- **上方路径（新）：** LC Sigmas 构建 schedule，LC Detail Daemon 增加细节，两个 sampler 分工合作（先 first pass，再 second pass）。
- **下方路径（基线）：** 一个普通的 KSampler，euler / simple。这就是"你通常会得到的结果"。
- 这里的每个设置都来自一次 3,432 张图像的测试，涵盖 Krea 2 Turbo 和 Raw、Z-Image、Flux 2 Klein、SDXL 和 Illustrious。

---

**LC Sigmas (BETA) 📉**
- sigma 就是某一步还剩下多少噪声。schedule 就是从头到尾这些数值的列表。大噪声 = 模型决定大的东西（姿势、构图、光线）。小噪声 = 细节（皮肤、头发、织物）。
- **sampler：** 图表下方的绿线告诉你，对你的模型及其 shift 来说什么测试结果最好（Krea 2 用它自己的 shift：euler + beta57）。RES4LYF / ClownShark 的 sampler 也能用，ClownSampler Selector 可以直接接进来。
- **sigma_curve_presets：** schedule 的形状。**base** = 普通 scheduler（在 **base_scheduler** 里选），**beta** = 你自己的 alpha / beta，**flowmatch**、**hyperbolic** 和 **gaussian** = 用 tanh、钟形曲线等弯折后的基础曲线，另外还有任何你保存的曲线。只会显示你所选项对应的设置。
- **在图表上拖动一个点** 来弯折曲线。**smooth** 会带动相邻的点（**smooth_radius** = 带动多少个），**spike** 只移动那一个点。**reset curve** 撤销，**save curve** 把它保存为预设。
- 图表显示你的 schedule：橙色 = first pass，蓝色 = second pass，虚线 = 模型的普通 schedule（或你弯折之前的预设）。运行过一次之后会实时更新。把节点拖高，图表也会变大。
- **step_swap** 把渲染拆成两个 pass。0 = 一个 pass。第二个模型（model_2）可以接手 second pass，并且它总是从 first pass 结束的噪声水平处精确开始（没有跳变）。
- **first_pass_resample：** 沿着同一条路径用更多步数走完 first pass。1 = 关闭。
- **low_pass：** **continue noise schedule** = second pass 完成剩余的噪声。**renoise** = first pass 完成图片，然后新的噪声被加回到 swap 的水平，这样干净的模型就有东西可以精修。清理 ControlNet 就用这个。step swap 决定它能得到多少：靠后 = 清理，靠前 = 更重的精修。
- **denoise** 用于图生图。信息行会告诉你真正的起始噪声，因为在 Krea 2 上 "denoise 0.5" 实际上是从 76% 的噪声开始的。**denoise_steps：** **full schedule** = denoise 覆盖整个运行过程。**at step swap** = 只覆盖 first pass，这样 second pass 会自己精修。
- **sigma_shift：** 保持在 **use model default**。shift 越高 = 在构图上花的步数越多，越低 = 在细节上越多。flowmatch 和已保存的曲线会忽略它。
- ⚠️ 向下拖动 **gaussian** 曲线时要轻一点。它本来就让噪声保持在高位，拖得太多会截断细节步骤，把画面烧坏。
- 它还会输出每个 pass 的噪声和 sampler，所以你不需要 RandomNoise、DisableNoise 或 KSamplerSelect 节点。

**LC Detail Daemon (BETA) 😈**
- 通过告诉模型噪声比实际上少一点来增加细节，这样它去掉得少一点，保留更多精细纹理。
- **amount** 与原版 Detail Daemon 使用相同的刻度（1.0 = 峰值处少 10% 的噪声），但它绝不会乘以你的 CFG。
- **start / end** 和原版一样是步数：0.15 到 0.85。
- **peak** 和 **exponent** 的作用比 amount 更大。**peak 0** = 在窗口开头最强，也就是塑造画面的嘈杂步骤上。**exponent 0** = 整个窗口内保持全强度。
- **mode：**
    - **look only**（默认）：清晰的细节，没有大的重新洗牌。
    - **classic：** 原版。小东西会发生位移（褶皱、窗户、背景焦点）。
    - **keep structure：** 只保留变化中精细的部分，所以布局完全留在原处。大约慢 45%。
- ✋ 它放在 **low pass**（第二个 sampler）上。细节是在最后几步生成的；放在 first pass 上它会移动布局。
- 它的 **sigmas** 输入只用来画图表。窗口跟随它所接入的 sampler。
- ⚠️ 自带噪声的 sampler（dpmpp_2m_sde、euler_ancestral、er_sde、eta 0.5 的 ClownShark）加上 Detail Daemon 可能会留下斑点。用这些 sampler 时请降低 amount，或者就用 euler。

**基线**
- 普通 KSampler，euler / simple。在 image comparer 里与新路径对比，自己判断。

**最佳 LC Sigmas 设置**
| 模型 | sampler + base_scheduler | steps | step_swap (ControlNet) | Detail Daemon amount (look only, low pass) | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Krea 2 Turbo / Krealism** | euler + beta57 | 8 | 7 | 1.0 | 日常设置 |
| **Krea 2 Raw** | euler + beta57 | 20 - 30 | 18 - 27 | 0.5 | 步数越多 = 效果越猛 |
| **Krea 2 + ModelSamplingAuraFlow (shift 4)** | euler + simple | 8 - 10 | 7 - 8 | 1.0 | 在这个 shift 下用 beta57 = 颗粒感和粗糙的皮肤 |
| **Z-Image Turbo** | uni_pc + simple | 8 - 9 | 8 | 0.75 | 最能吸收细节 |
| **Flux 2 Klein** | uni_pc + simple | 4 | off | off | 步数太少：它只会移动光线，而不是增加细节 |
| **SDXL / Illustrious / Pony** | dpmpp_2m + karras | 25 - 30 | 23 - 27 | 0.75 | 这里 Karras 没问题，flow 模型上则不行 |

**最佳 Detail Daemon 设置**
| 预设 | amount | start | end | peak | exponent | mode | 推荐用于 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Balanced**（默认） | 1.0 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | look only | 日常使用 | 经过测试的设置 |
| **Gentle sharpen** | 0.5 | 0.20 | 0.80 | 0.5 | 1 | look only | 人像、皮肤 | 几乎不会移动任何东西 |
| **Original look** | 0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | classic | 旧版 Detail Daemon 的感觉 | 小东西会位移 |
| **Keep layout** | 0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | keep structure | 什么都不能动的时候 | 大约慢 45% |
| **Smooth** | -0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | look only | 杂乱或颗粒感重的渲染 | 负值 = 更平滑，细节更少 |

### 快速提示：
- **peak** 和 **exponent** 为 0 时冲击力最强。想要更温和的锐化就调高它们。
- **amount** 沿用原版 Detail Daemon 的刻度：1.0 = 峰值处少 10% 的噪声。
- **classic** 和 **keep structure** 比 look only 更猛：从一半的 amount 开始。
- **start / end：** 别动最后几步，否则图像里会残留噪声。
- 4 步模型：不值得。
- 💡 想要更快？把 **LC Speed Boost 🚀** 放在 LC Sigmas 的 sampler 和第一个 sampler 之间：大约 2 倍速，质量相同，取景会稍微收紧一点。

---

## 使い方
---

@[card: フォローしてね](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

@[card: フォローしてね](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

@[card: 私のツールはこちら](https://github.com/lonecatone23)

@[card: 私のモデルはこちら](https://huggingface.co/Lonecatone23)


@[card: ☕をおごる](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

### これは何時間もかけた作品です。気に入ったら、👍 いいね、💬 コメント、⚡ チップもお気軽にどうぞ 😉

---

### 🛑🚫✋ このワークフローの目的
- 2 つの新しいノード **LC Sigmas** と **LC Detail Daemon** のテストベンチです。同じプロンプト、同じモデルで 2 通りに実行し、comparer で違いを確認できます。
- **上の経路(新)**: LC Sigmas がスケジュールを作り、LC Detail Daemon がディテールを加え、2 つのサンプラーが作業を分担します(first pass、次に second pass)。
- **下の経路(ベースライン)**: euler / simple のごく普通の KSampler。「普通に得られるもの」です。
- ここにある設定はすべて、Krea 2 Turbo と Raw、Z-Image、Flux 2 Klein、SDXL、Illustrious での 3,432 枚のテストから出てきたものです。

---

**LC Sigmas (BETA) 📉**
- sigma とは、その step で残っているノイズの量のことです。スケジュールは、その量を最初から最後まで並べたリストです。ノイズが大きい = モデルが大きなこと(ポーズ、構図、光)を決める。ノイズが小さい = 細部(肌、髪、布地)。
- **sampler:** グラフの下の緑の線が、お使いのモデルとその shift で最もよかった組み合わせを教えてくれます(Krea 2 の標準 shift なら euler + beta57)。RES4LYF / ClownShark サンプラーも使え、ClownSampler Selector を直接つなぐこともできます。
- **sigma_curve_presets:** スケジュールの形。**base** = ごく普通のスケジューラー(**base_scheduler** で選択)、**beta** = 自分の alpha / beta、**flowmatch**、**hyperbolic**、**gaussian** = ベース曲線を tanh や釣鐘曲線などで曲げたもの、そして保存した曲線。選んだものの設定だけが表示されます。
- **グラフ上の点をドラッグ**して曲線を曲げます。**smooth** は周りの点も引っ張り(**smooth_radius** = 何点分)、**spike** はその点だけを動かします。**reset curve** で元に戻し、**save curve** でプリセットとして保存します。
- グラフにはスケジュールが表示されます: オレンジ = first pass、青 = second pass、破線 = モデルの標準スケジュール(曲げる前のプリセット)。一度実行すると、ライブで更新されます。ノードを縦に伸ばすとグラフも大きくなります。
- **step_swap** はレンダリングを 2 つのパスに分けます。0 = 1 パス。2 つ目のモデル(model_2)に second pass を任せることもでき、必ず first pass が止まったノイズレベルのちょうどそこから始まります(ジャンプなし)。
- **first_pass_resample:** 同じ経路を、より多くの steps で first pass を進みます。1 = オフ。
- **low_pass:** **continue noise schedule** = second pass が残りのノイズを仕上げる。**renoise** = first pass が画像を完成させ、その後 swap レベルまで新しいノイズを戻して、きれいなモデルに磨く余地を与える。ControlNet のクリーンアップにはこれを使います。step swap が、どれだけ与えるかを決めます: 遅い = クリーンアップ、早め = より強い磨き込み。
- **denoise** は image to image 用です。情報行が実際の開始ノイズを教えてくれます。Krea 2 では「denoise 0.5」が実際には 76% のノイズから始まるためです。**denoise_steps:** **full schedule** = denoise が全体をカバー。**at step swap** = first pass のみをカバーするので、second pass は単独で磨き込みます。
- **sigma_shift:** **use model default** のままにしてください。shift が高い = 構図に多くの steps、低い = 細部に多く。flowmatch と保存した曲線では無視されます。
- ⚠️ **gaussian** 曲線を下にドラッグするときは控えめに。すでにノイズが高く保たれているので、大きくドラッグすると細部の steps が削られて画像が焼けます。
- 各パス用のノイズとサンプラーも出力するので、RandomNoise、DisableNoise、KSamplerSelect ノードは不要です。

**LC Detail Daemon (BETA) 😈**
- 実際よりノイズが少し少ないとモデルに伝えることでディテールを加えます。モデルが取り除く量が少し減り、細かいテクスチャが残ります。
- **amount** は元の Detail Daemon と同じスケールです(1.0 = ピーク時にノイズ 10% 減)が、CFG が掛かることはありません。
- **start / end** は元のものと同様に steps です: 0.15 から 0.85。
- **peak** と **exponent** は amount より効きます。**peak 0** = ウィンドウの開始時、形を作るノイズの多い steps で最強。**exponent 0** = ウィンドウ全体で全開。
- **mode:**
    - **look only**(デフォルト): 大きな組み替えなしの、シャープなディテール。
    - **classic:** オリジナル。小さなものが動きます(しわ、窓、背景のピント)。
    - **keep structure:** 変化の細かい部分だけを残すので、レイアウトは完全にそのまま。約 45% 遅くなります。
- ✋ **low pass**(2 つ目のサンプラー)に置きます。ディテールは最後の steps で作られます。first pass に置くとレイアウトが動きます。
- その **sigmas** 入力はグラフを描くためだけのものです。ウィンドウは、つないだサンプラーに従います。
- ⚠️ 独自にノイズを加えるサンプラー(dpmpp_2m_sde、euler_ancestral、er_sde、eta 0.5 の ClownShark)と Detail Daemon を組み合わせると、斑点が残ることがあります。それらでは amount を下げるか、euler にしてください。

**ベースライン**
- ごく普通の KSampler、euler / simple。image comparer で新しい経路と比べて、自分で判断してください。

**LC Sigmas のベスト設定**
| モデル | sampler + base_scheduler | steps | step_swap (ControlNet) | Detail Daemon amount (look only, low pass) | 備考 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Krea 2 Turbo / Krealism** | euler + beta57 | 8 | 7 | 1.0 | 普段使いの設定 |
| **Krea 2 Raw** | euler + beta57 | 20 - 30 | 18 - 27 | 0.5 | steps が多いほど強く効きます |
| **Krea 2 + ModelSamplingAuraFlow (shift 4)** | euler + simple | 8 - 10 | 7 - 8 | 1.0 | この shift で beta57 だとザラつきとカリカリの肌になります |
| **Z-Image Turbo** | uni_pc + simple | 8 - 9 | 8 | 0.75 | ディテールが最もよく乗ります |
| **Flux 2 Klein** | uni_pc + simple | 4 | off | off | steps が少なすぎて、ディテールではなく光がずれます |
| **SDXL / Illustrious / Pony** | dpmpp_2m + karras | 25 - 30 | 23 - 27 | 0.75 | ここでは Karras で問題なし。flow モデルでは不可 |

**Detail Daemon のベスト設定**

**LC Sigmas (BETA) 📉**

Only the settings for the one you pick show up.
- **Drag a point on the graph** to bend the curve. **smooth** pulls the neighbours along (**smooth_radius** = how many), **spike** moves just that point. **reset curve** undoes it, **save curve** keeps it as a preset.
- The graph shows your schedule: orange = first pass, blue = second pass, dashed = the model's plain schedule (or your preset before you bent it). It updates live once you have run it. Drag the node taller and the graph grows.
- **step_swap** splits the render into two passes. 0 = one pass. A second model (model_2) can take the second pass, and it always starts at exactly the noise level where the first stopped (no jump).
- **first_pass_resample:** walks the first pass in more steps along the same path. 1 = off.
- **low_pass:** **continue noise schedule** = the second pass finishes the leftover noise. **renoise** = the first pass finishes the picture, then fresh noise goes back up to the swap level, so the clean model has something to refine. This is the one for cleaning up ControlNet. The step swap sets how much it gets: late = clean-up, earlier = heavier refining.
- **denoise** is for image to image. The info line tells you the real starting noise, because on Krea 2 "denoise 0.5" actually starts at 76% noise. **denoise_steps:** **full schedule** = denoise covers the whole run. **at step swap** = it covers the first pass only, so the second pass refines on its own.
- **sigma_shift:** leave it on **use model default**. Higher shift = more steps on composition, lower = more on detail. flowmatch and saved curves ignore it.
- ⚠️ Go easy dragging a **gaussian** curve down. It already keeps the noise high, and a big drag cuts the detail steps short and burns the picture.

- **start / end** are steps, like the original: 0.15 to 0.85.

- Its **sigmas** input only draws the graph. The window follows the sampler it is plugged into.
- ⚠️ Samplers that add their own noise (dpmpp_2m_sde, euler_ancestral, er_sde, ClownShark at eta 0.5) plus Detail Daemon can leave specks. Lower the amount with those, or stay on euler.

| **Krea 2 Raw** | euler + beta57 | 20 - 30 | 18 - 27 | 0.5 | More steps = it hits harder |
| **Krea 2 + ModelSamplingAuraFlow (shift 4)** | euler + simple | 8 - 10 | 7 - 8 | 1.0 | beta57 at this shift = grain and crunchy skin |
| **Z-Image Turbo** | uni_pc + simple | 8 - 9 | 8 | 0.75 | Takes detail the best |
| **Flux 2 Klein** | uni_pc + simple | 4 | off | off | Too few steps: it shifts the light instead of adding detail |
| **SDXL / Illustrious / Pony** | dpmpp_2m + karras | 25 - 30 | 23 - 27 | 0.75 | Karras is fine here, not on flow models |

**Best Detail Daemon Settings**
| Preset | amount | start | end | peak | exponent | mode | Recommended for | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Balanced** (default) | 1.0 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | look only | Everyday use | The tested setting |
| **Gentle sharpen** | 0.5 | 0.20 | 0.80 | 0.5 | 1 | look only | Portraits, skin | Barely moves anything |
| **Original look** | 0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | classic | The old Detail Daemon feel | Small things shift |
| **Keep layout** | 0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | keep structure | When nothing may move | About 45% slower |
| **Smooth** | -0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | look only | Busy or grainy renders | Negative = smoother, less detail |

### Quick Tips:
- **peak** and **exponent** at 0 is where the punch comes from. Raise them for a gentler sharpen.
- **amount** is the original Detail Daemon's scale: 1.0 = 10% less noise at the peak.
- **classic** and **keep structure** hit harder than look only: start them at half the amount.
- **start / end:** leave the last steps alone, or noise stays in the image.
- 4-step models: not worth it.

- **step_swap** splits the render into two passes. 0 = one pass. A second model (model_2) can take the second pass, and it always starts at exactly the noise level where the first stopped (no jump).
- **first_pass_resample:** walks the first pass in more steps along the same path. 1 = off.
- **low_pass:** **continue noise schedule** = the second pass finishes the leftover noise. **renoise** = the first pass finishes the picture, then fresh noise goes back up to the swap level, so the clean model has something to refine. This is the one for cleaning up ControlNet. The step swap sets how much it gets: late = clean-up, earlier = heavier refining.
- **denoise** is for image to image. The info line tells you the real starting noise, because on Krea 2 "denoise 0.5" actually starts at 76% noise. **denoise_steps:** **full schedule** = denoise covers the whole run. **at step swap** = it covers the first pass only, so the second pass refines on its own.
- **sigma_shift:** leave it on **use model default**. Higher shift = more steps on composition, lower = more on detail. flowmatch and saved curves ignore it.
- ⚠️ Go easy dragging a **gaussian** curve down. It already keeps the noise high, and a big drag cuts the detail steps short and burns the picture.
- It also outputs the noise for each pass and the sampler, so you do not need RandomNoise, DisableNoise or KSamplerSelect nodes.

**LC Detail Daemon (BETA) 😈**
- Adds detail by telling the model there is a little less noise than there really is, so it removes a little less and keeps more fine texture.
- **amount** uses the same scale as the original Detail Daemon (1.0 = 10% less noise at the peak), but it is never multiplied by your CFG.
- **start / end** are steps, like the original: 0.15 to 0.85.
- **peak** and **exponent** do more than the amount. **peak 0** = strongest at the start of the window, on the noisy steps where it shapes things. **exponent 0** = full strength across the whole window.
- **mode:**
    - **look only** (default): crisp detail without big reshuffles.
    - **classic:** the original. Small things shift (folds, windows, background focus).
    - **keep structure:** only the fine part of the change is kept, so the layout stays exactly where it was. About 45% slower.
- ✋ It sits on the **low pass** (the second sampler). Detail is made in the last steps; on the first pass it moves the layout.
- Its **sigmas** input only draws the graph. The window follows the sampler it is plugged into.
- ⚠️ Samplers that add their own noise (dpmpp_2m_sde, euler_ancestral, er_sde, ClownShark at eta 0.5) plus Detail Daemon can leave specks. Lower the amount with those, or stay on euler.

**Baseline**
- Plain KSampler, euler / simple. Compare it against the new path in the image comparer and judge for yourself.

**Best LC Sigmas Settings**
| Model | sampler + base_scheduler | steps | step_swap (ControlNet) | Detail Daemon amount (look only, low pass) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Krea 2 Turbo / Krealism** | euler + beta57 | 8 | 7 | 1.0 | The everyday setup |
| **Krea 2 Raw** | euler + beta57 | 20 - 30 | 18 - 27 | 0.5 | More steps = it hits harder |
| **Krea 2 + ModelSamplingAuraFlow (shift 4)** | euler + simple | 8 - 10 | 7 - 8 | 1.0 | beta57 at this shift = grain and crunchy skin |
| **Z-Image Turbo** | uni_pc + simple | 8 - 9 | 8 | 0.75 | Takes detail the best |
| **Flux 2 Klein** | uni_pc + simple | 4 | off | off | Too few steps: it shifts the light instead of adding detail |
| **SDXL / Illustrious / Pony** | dpmpp_2m + karras | 25 - 30 | 23 - 27 | 0.75 | Karras is fine here, not on flow models |

**Best Detail Daemon Settings**
| Preset | amount | start | end | peak | exponent | mode | Recommended for | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Balanced** (default) | 1.0 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | look only | Everyday use | The tested setting |
| **Gentle sharpen** | 0.5 | 0.20 | 0.80 | 0.5 | 1 | look only | Portraits, skin | Barely moves anything |
| **Original look** | 0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | classic | The old Detail Daemon feel | Small things shift |
| **Keep layout** | 0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | keep structure | When nothing may move | About 45% slower |
| **Smooth** | -0.5 | 0.15 | 0.85 | 0 | 0 | look only | Busy or grainy renders | Negative = smoother, less detail |

### Quick Tips:
- **peak** and **exponent** at 0 is where the punch comes from. Raise them for a gentler sharpen.
- **amount** is the original Detail Daemon's scale: 1.0 = 10% less noise at the peak.
- **classic** and **keep structure** hit harder than look only: start them at half the amount.
- **start / end:** leave the last steps alone, or noise stays in the image.
- 4-step models: not worth it.
- 💡 Want it faster? Put **LC Speed Boost 🚀** between LC Sigmas' sampler and the first sampler: about 2x, same quality, the framing gets a bit tighter.

---

## LC Vision Caption 📝

**LC Vision Loader 🔬**:
- ⚠️ This auto downloads the model you choose on the first run, so it will take several minutes.
- The model selector shows your already downloaded options as well as available downloads.

**LC Vision Caption 📝**:
- 💡 The node analyzes the image and detects subject, pose, clothing, setting, lighting, color, composition, and mood, not just a one-line summary.
- Each reference gets its own label (`<Reference 1>`, `<Reference 2>`, `<Reference 3>`), described individually instead of mashed into one blob. 😎
- `style_tag` pushes the description toward a specific visual style regardless of what the reference actually looks like.

**💡 Analyzing 3 images at once**
- Custom prompt: "Analyze <Reference 1>, <Reference 2>, and <Reference 3> individually: describe each one's subject, setting, lighting, and mood. Then compare all three and note the key similarities and differences between them."
- The model addresses each picture by its own label instead of blending them together.

en.text:
### ✋ How to use

**1. Use I2I 🖼️ (toggle)**
- **Off:** text to image. The empty latent comes from LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier.
- **On:** image to image from **Load Image**. Then set **denoise** on LC Sigmas below 1 (start at 0.6). At 1 your picture gets fully replaced.

**2. LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier 📐**
- Pick a size preset (or custom width / height). This sets the size of everything.

**3. LC Model Optimizer ⚡**
- **base_model:** match your model (Krea 2 Turbo for Krealism).
- **goal:** Optimal is the safe pick. Fast trades a little quality for speed.

**4. Your prompt / Use Prompt Assist 📝 (toggle)**
- Type your prompt in **Your Prompt**.
- **Use Prompt Assist on:** LC Vision describes your loaded image and adds it to your prompt. Off = your prompt only.
- **Final Prompt** shows exactly what gets sent.

**5. LC Seed 🌱**
- One seed for the whole run. Fix it when you compare settings, so only the setting changes.

**6. LC Sigmas 📉**
- **sampler:** euler on Krea 2. The green line under the graph says what tested best for your model.
- **sigma_curve_presets:** base, with **base_scheduler** on beta57 for Krea 2 (simple when a ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 4 sits in front of the model). Drag the graph to bend it, **reset curve** to undo.
- **steps:** total steps for both passes. Krea 2 Turbo: 8. Krea 2 Raw: 28 or more.
- **step_swap:** 0 = one pass. For two passes leave the low pass 3 to 4 steps (8 of 12, 6 of 10): LC Detail Daemon works there.
- **low_pass:** **continue noise schedule**, or **renoise** when a second model on model_2 is cleaning up.
- **denoise:** 1 for text to image. 0.4 to 0.7 for image to image. **denoise_steps:** full schedule.
- **sigma_shift:** leave on use model default.

**7. LC Detail Daemon 😈**
- Wired into the **low pass** sampler. Detail is made in the last steps.
- **amount:** 1.0 with look only on Krea 2 / Krealism. classic and keep structure hit harder: start at half.
- **start / end:** 0.15 and 0.85.
- **peak:** 0 = strongest at the start of the window, where it shapes things. **exponent:** 0 = full strength across the whole window. Those two do more than the amount.
- **mode:** look only (default) for crisp detail without reshuffles. classic for the original look, keep structure when the layout must not move.

**8. Compare**
- The image comparer shows the baseline (A) against the new path (B). Drag across it.

---

- 在 **Your Prompt** 里输入提示词。
- **Use Prompt Assist 开：** LC Vision 会描述你载入的图像，并加到你的提示词里。关 = 只用你的提示词。
- **Final Prompt** 会准确显示最终发送的内容。

- 整个运行共用一个 seed。对比设置时把它固定住，这样变化的只有设置本身。

**6. LC Sigmas 📉**
- **sampler：** Krea 2 用 euler。图表下方的绿线会告诉你对你的模型来说什么测试效果最好。
- **sigma_curve_presets：** base，Krea 2 的 **base_scheduler** 用 beta57（如果模型前面放了 ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 4，则用 simple）。拖动图表可以弯曲曲线，**reset curve** 可以撤销。

- **sigma_shift：** 保持 use model default。

- 接到 **low pass** 采样器上。细节是在最后几步里生成的。
- **amount：** Krea 2 / Krealism 上 look only 模式用 1.0。classic 和 keep structure 更猛：从一半开始。

**8. 对比**
- 图像对比器会把基线（A）和新路径（B）放在一起。左右拖动查看。

- **Your Prompt** にプロンプトを入力します。
- **Use Prompt Assist on:** LC Vision が読み込んだ画像を説明し、プロンプトに追加します。Off = あなたのプロンプトだけです。
- **Final Prompt** には、実際に送られる内容がそのまま表示されます。

**5. LC Seed 🌱**
- 実行全体で1つの seed です。設定を比較するときは固定して、設定だけが変わるようにしてください。

**6. LC Sigmas 📉**
- **sampler:** Krea 2 では euler。グラフの下の緑の線に、あなたのモデルで最もテスト結果が良かったものが表示されます。
- **sigma_curve_presets:** base。Krea 2 では **base_scheduler** を beta57 にします（モデルの前に ModelSamplingAuraFlow の shift 4 がある場合は simple）。グラフをドラッグすると曲線を曲げられ、**reset curve** で元に戻せます。
- **steps:** 2パスの合計ステップ数。Krea 2 Turbo: 8。Krea 2 Raw: 28 以上。
- **step_swap:** 0 = 1パス。2パスにする場合は、low pass を 3〜4 ステップにします（12 のうち 8、10 のうち 6）。LC Detail Daemon がそこで働きます。
- **low_pass:** **continue noise schedule**、または model_2 の2つ目のモデルが仕上げをする場合は **renoise**。
- **denoise:** text to image は 1。image to image は 0.4〜0.7。**denoise_steps:** 完全なスケジュール。
- **sigma_shift:** use model default のままにします。

**7. LC Detail Daemon 😈**
- **low pass** サンプラーに接続します。ディテールは最後のステップで作られます。
- **amount:** Krea 2 / Krealism では look only で 1.0。classic と keep structure はより強く効くので、半分から始めてください。
- **start / end:** 0.15 と 0.85。
- **peak:** 0 = ウィンドウの開始地点で最も強くなり、そこで形を作ります。**exponent:** 0 = ウィンドウ全体でフル強度。この2つは amount よりも効きます。
- **mode:** look only（デフォルト）は、並べ替えなしでくっきりしたディテールになります。classic は元の見た目、keep structure はレイアウトを動かしたくないとき。

**8. 比較**
- 画像比較ノードで、ベースライン（A）と新しい経路（B）を比べられます。ドラッグして比べてください。

### ✋ How to use

- **Off:** text to image. The empty latent comes from LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier.
- **On:** image to image from **Load Image**. Then set **denoise** on LC Sigmas below 1 (start at 0.6). At 1 your picture gets fully replaced.

- Pick a size preset (or custom width / height). This sets the size of everything.

**3. LC Model Optimizer ⚡**
- **base_model:** match your model (Krea 2 Turbo for Krealism).
- **goal:** Optimal is the safe pick. Fast trades a little quality for speed.

**4. Your prompt / Use Prompt Assist 📝 (toggle)**
- Type your prompt in **Your Prompt**.
- **Use Prompt Assist on:** LC Vision describes your loaded image and adds it to your prompt. Off = your prompt only.
- **Final Prompt** shows exactly what gets sent.

**5. LC Seed 🌱**
- One seed for the whole run. Fix it when you compare settings, so only the setting changes.

**6. LC Sigmas 📉**
- **sampler:** euler on Krea 2. The green line under the graph says what tested best for your model.
- **sigma_curve_presets:** base, with **base_scheduler** on beta57 for Krea 2 (simple when a ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 4 sits in front of the model). Drag the graph to bend it, **reset curve** to undo.
- **steps:** total steps for both passes. Krea 2 Turbo: 8. Krea 2 Raw: 28 or more.
- **step_swap:** 0 = one pass. For two passes leave the low pass 3 to 4 steps (8 of 12, 6 of 10): LC Detail Daemon works there.
- **low_pass:** **continue noise schedule**, or **renoise** when a second model on model_2 is cleaning up.
- **denoise:** 1 for text to image. 0.4 to 0.7 for image to image. **denoise_steps:** full schedule.
- **sigma_shift:** leave on use model default.

**7. LC Detail Daemon 😈**
- Wired into the **low pass** sampler. Detail is made in the last steps.
- **amount:** 1.0 with look only on Krea 2 / Krealism. classic and keep structure hit harder: start at half.
- **start / end:** 0.15 and 0.85.
- **peak:** 0 = strongest at the start of the window, where it shapes things. **exponent:** 0 = full strength across the whole window. Those two do more than the amount.
- **mode:** look only (default) for crisp detail without reshuffles. classic for the original look, keep structure when the layout must not move.

**8. Compare**
- The image comparer shows the baseline (A) against the new path (B). Drag across it.
